title: EDAS assembly-knowledge metaschema
description: Validates edas-knowledge/1 documents. SEPARATE from the EDES metaschema on purpose: EDAS owns assembly-level knowledge (build sequence, chaining, ownership arbitration, section-vs-contact, associations, emit format) and EDES owns component-level knowledge, and a single schema covering both would let a field drift between the two layers without either rejecting it. Currently one document kind, edas:SharedReference; per-archetype documents are deliberately NOT modelled, because the archetypes in standard_ils_layouts.json already carry their own purpose, constraints, variables and expected outputs, and restating them here would create the stale-pointer class this project has been caught by before.
strictnessPhase: EDAS is younger than EDES and its sections are still moving. Section BODIES are therefore looseObject -- their internal shape is not fixed. What IS enforced: the document kind, the identifier, and the PRESENCE of every section, so a section cannot be silently dropped in an edit. Tighten individual bodies as they settle, the way EDES tightened artifactType and permittedConnections once their shapes stopped changing.

task.description: The DIRECTIVE block, and the reason it must be first: a reader that does not meet the deliverable immediately will infer one. Observed 5Sep26 -- a model given photographs of layouts read EDAS, correctly found nothing about page layout, and asked whether to emit .docx or markdown, because the deliverable was then buried four sections deep.

architecture.description: The four inputs (EDES, EDIKB, EDAS, EDPR), the single output, and the verification loop back through build_ils.

buildSequence.description: Parts, then names, then connections. Connections cannot be declared against parts with no identity.

chaining.description: The adjacency equation and everything that governs whether two parts actually meet: halfExtent per component, emission precision, exact arithmetic, and what the coincidence check is for.

topologyTypes.description: chain / nested / off-line / branch. An ILS is not a sequence -- verified against all 7 archetypes.

sectionVersusContact.description: Which components claim the pipe section, which claim only contact, and why ownership='lowest' cannot resolve a section conflict. The distinction that decides whether a component may nest or the header must be split around it.

associationVocabulary.description: Connection (F/P/S/D/W) and PositionOrientation: format, what is validated, the datum, and how weld associations are generated.

knownGaps.description: REQUIRED and required to be non-empty. A knowledge layer that claims no gaps is not complete, it is unexamined -- and this one has real ones (no 2D clash detection, header model undecided, EDIKB and EDPR unbuilt).

branchLayouts.description: Everything specific to a edes:GD-B layout: L vs Z variant and which structure edge each meets, that a branch needs no support structure, P_bc semantics and its degradation to a warning when standalone, support_connector values, and the one-sided extent.

connectorAttachment.description: How a connector reaches the pipeline: never directly onto plain header pipe, but via a thickened section introduced at the connection point. Includes the vertical-connector constraint and which slot each connection system populates.

looseObject.description: Any object. Used where a section's internal shape is still settling -- see strictnessPhase.
